cards.name: Compiler
cards.about: Slow wall that hits hard. Play it first.

cards.name: Kernel
cards.about: The toughest wall in the deck. Slow and steady.

cards.name: Algorithmist
cards.about: Shoots from three tiles away. Keep it behind a wall.

cards.name: Optimizer
cards.about: Short-range shooter with a heavy punch.

cards.name: Logic Bomber
cards.about: Long shots that also hurt everyone next to the target.

cards.name: Debugger
cards.about: Quick, cheap and sticks to the road.

cards.name: Stack Runner
cards.about: Very fast, very fragile. Cuts straight through mud.

cards.name: Cloud Drone
cards.about: Floats over grass and mud. Shoots from two tiles away.
